questions: Is the eye closure happening on one side or both sides of your face?
Do you have any other movements or tics, besides the eye closure?
Does anything make the eye closure better or worse (like stress, light, or touch)?
Did this start suddenly or come on gradually over time?
Is it constant, or does it come and go?
Does it interfere with your ability to read, watch TV, or drive?
Do your eyes water, become sensitive to light, or feel gritty when it happens?
Do you have a family history of similar movements or tics?
Have you ever had any other neurological problems (like a tremor or weakness)?
Have you been taking any new medications?
